v1.feedback: The concentric-sphere shell structure is legible but generic — five nested particle spheres don't carry the formal ambition of 8ug's layered audio shells. The mischief scatter reads as a nice gesture but during the hold phase the fleeing particles lose coherence and approach noise-blob territory; tighten the scatter radius (cap scatterR at ~4.0) and bias the spiral more tangentially so the shell visibly unravels rather than exploding. Palette is correctly restrained. Consider giving the non-mischief shells a subtle sympathetic flinch (slight inward contraction) when one shell scatters — that interplay would sell 'mischief' as social, not just kinetic.

v2.feedback: The mischief mechanic (tangential unravel + sympathetic flinch) is a genuinely clever swerve on the 8ug audio-shell lineage, and the amber-to-slate palette stays restrained. But five concentric particle spheres still read as noise blobs without a recognizable silhouette — the form needs structural differentiation (faceted polyhedra, latitude banding, or shell-specific topology like a torus vs icosahedron) so the viewer can identify which shell is misbehaving before the unravel begins. Consider giving each shell a distinct geometric skeleton (geodesic wireframe, ring lattice) rather than uniform random scatter, so the mischief reads as a legible event against a legible form.
